metadata.description: The evidence of one package's installation contributions (PROP-065#ordinary-plan): `steps.json` in `<home>/cache/install-steps/<group>/<name>/<version>/<timestamp>/`, one row per `slot:` contribution the run judged, beside `logs/<id>.log`. Derived state — it is listed and cleaned by the ordinary cache surface, and nothing resumes from it. Rewritten as each contribution ends, so an interrupted run leaves the rows it had reached.
Every judged contribution of this package, in the order the run reached them: the ones that ran, the ones a condition skipped, and the one that failed or was interrupted.
Absent while the run is in flight, and on a run that was interrupted before it could close the record.
The package whose contributions these are.

The engine's own transition statuses, carried verbatim rather than mapped: `ok` ran, `skip` was decided against by a condition or an unmet need of an optional row, `fresh` needed no rerun, `fail` failed, `delegated` was parked for a hosting agent, `interrupted` ended under a requested stop (PROP-065#ordinary-failure).

One `slot:` contribution: its author-written `id`, the execution key the lifecycle state records it under, the point, the handler kind, the outcome, the reason a skip or a failure carries, and when it started and finished.
The deciding condition of a skip, or the failure's own message including the retry it names.
Absent on a row that never started — a skip is decided, not run.
This contribution's log, relative to the record directory (`logs/<id>.log`). Absent when the run produced no bytes for it, or when its child wrote straight to the terminal.
True when the engine's stream capture bound was reached, so the log holds the first megabyte of that stream and not all of it.
